correctness.rationale: Exact Kreweras block profile count; finite list of all feasible integer profiles for n=5 through n=8; the covariance numerator is exactly -n P_n(q). value.rationale: A full phase classification across the first four feasible finite NC orders reveals two bona fide positive-fugacity sign transitions and repeated +,-,+,- covariance behavior at one natural q. This is a boundary for interpreting the known unweighted and asymptotic negative correlations and gives exact parameter thresholds for finite Gibbs NC model testing. It is limited to four orders without unsupported global extrapolation.
